The First Deception
Key Event
The Origin
The Darkness Separates Hecate from Gaia
Gaia’s daughter. Born from the Earth itself — the first mother, the oldest source. The Darkness — the primal force the Veil was built to hold back — finds her in her mother’s presence and tells her the first lie: that the warmth she lives in is a cage, that her true inheritance waits beyond the boundary, that her mother’s love is limitation wearing the shape of protection.
Hecate steps toward the Veil’s edge to see for herself. The Darkness pulls her past it. She finds her way back — but only to the boundary’s edge, not to Gaia. She takes her position as the Veil’s keeper from the outside. She has been holding the Darkness back from that edge ever since.
HecateGaiaThe Darkness

The Practice Begins
Pre-History
The Daughters’ Practice — The First Hollow Witch
The Bone Mother’s channel first used. The daughters’ tradition established in the mortal layer. It predates the Older Mechanism, the Grigori’s commission, and the formal framework. The Web was always there. They found it awake.

12,000 BCE
The First Compact
Key Event
Pre-History
Arcadia — The First Practitioner · The First Word · The Seal
Arcadia — the first Omni Witch in history — stands above the Leviathan’s heart in the Pike County back field and chooses across the geological scale difference. The Leviathan chooses back. The Familiar bond’s first correct expression.
She writes the first word in the soil above the Leviathan’s heart: here.
Satan kills her immediately after. Her death requires a seal. The wrong compact — the fear-and-control architecture, Satan’s prison lock — begins its twelve-thousand-year operation. The first word survives in the geology because the geological record cannot be taken.
ArcadiaThe LeviathanSatan

Date uncertain
Pre-History
The Grigori Descend · The 200 Watchers
Samyaza proposes the oath: if I am alone in this I will carry the blame alone; if we are together in this the weight is shared. Two hundred Watchers descend. They are punished and bound in the same geological layer as the Leviathan’s sealed position — they do not know this. Saraqael is assigned to Heaven’s Enforcement Arm as his specific punishment: the Watcher who reads the earth’s signs made to enforce the institutional claim over what the earth’s signs say.

The Order Founded

Lucifer Founds the Order of Shadows
Seven brothers take the founding oath. The True Fallen binding ties them to the Church’s institutional structure. Brother Anselm takes the founding oath. He will carry it for 600 years.

~53 Years Before Year 0
Mama Calhoun’s Tenure Begins
Pre-History
Mama Calhoun Begins Holding the Thinning
Eudora Calhoun, 89 years old by the time the compact is ratified, begins her tenure as Pike County’s Thinning holder. She is the sixth Calhoun generation. She will hold the door for fifty-three years. The holding was the waiting. The waiting was for the configuration that made the opening possible.
Mama Calhoun (Eudora)
~62 Years Before Year 0
Anselm’s First Refusal
Pre-History · OS4
Anselm Refuses to Kill the Thinning’s Holder
Anselm — last survivor of the Order’s founding generation — is sent to eliminate the Pike County corridor’s anchor. He finds her in her garden. She says: you look tired. Come in. He sits at her kitchen table for forty minutes. He files a false report. This is the first crack in the Order’s maintenance structure. He will carry this refusal for sixty more years.
AnselmMama Calhoun
~30 Years Before Year 0
Samyaza Comes to Combs Property
Pre-History · Book 2
Samyaza First Attends the Combs Property · Della Is Eight
Samyaza — the first name on the list, the Horde’s general — begins his thirty-year attendance at Della Combs’s property. Della is eight years old. She sets a cup of water out for a shape no one else can see. In case he’s thirsty. He will stand at the east wood for twenty-three mornings before she walks to the fence.

Year 0 · Fire Solstice
Book 1 · Fallin’ for a Fallen
Key Event
Book 1
The Compact Ratified · Dixie & Azazel · The Seven-Year Cycle Begins
Raelee “Dixie” Calhoun — seventh Calhoun generation, musician, three outstanding warrants — turns down a road she’s never taken before. The compact she builds is real, which Mama Calhoun says is stronger than a planned arrangement would have been. The Morvael deal dissolved. The wrong compact replaced. The Pike County corridor’s jurisdiction formalized under the Older Mechanism’s bond law. The door opens.
The compact is ratified on the fire solstice — the longest day, the sun at its peak. The Older Mechanism’s record notes the date. Seven years later, on this same solstice, the Restoration will close the cycle.
Dixie CalhounAzazelMama Calhoun
Year 0
Book 2 · The Devil’s in the Details
Key Event
Book 2
Della & Samyaza · Brian Lee · Asmodeus Defeated
On the twenty-third morning Della Combs walks to the east fence. Samyaza tells her the truth. She tells him to get out of her house. She screams into a dish towel for forty-five seconds, washes it, goes back to work.
Asmodeus (Prince of Lust, 2nd-ranked on Hell’s administrative council) comes with a writ of acquisition for Brian Lee Combs — first Nephilim born to a chief Watcher in twelve thousand years. The writ rests on the Flood Clause — the framework’s founding Commission once ordered all Nephilim destroyed (Goliath as precedent), and it argues Brian Lee is not of the mortal layer, therefore unclaimed, therefore available; Asmodeus races the compact to close his claim first. The Cain-Abel clause defeats him: choosing betrayal as architecture binds his life force to Samyaza’s permanently. The older claim wins. It has always won.
Della CombsSamyazaBrian Lee CombsAsmodeus

Book 3
Carla June & Baraqiel · The Warm Room

Book 4 · All Hell Breaks Loose

Mercy & Armaros · The Older Idiom

Mercy wins not by out-powering him but by being the thing he gave up on being: a practitioner who does not hold alone.
Mercy TackettArmarosAsmodeus

The Darkness Repeats the Original Lie · Hecate Displaced · The Veil Dissolves

Year 7 · Fire Solstice
DA12 · The Restoration
Key Event
DA12
Gaia and Hecate · The Fire Solstice · The Seven-Year Cycle Closes
The same fire solstice. Seven years after Dixie ratified the compact on the longest day of Year 0 — the same solar position, the same Older Mechanism calendar point, the same day the compact’s record was first opened — the Restoration happens.
Gaia and Hecate. The reunion. The Darkness told Hecate her mother’s warmth was a cage. The Restoration answers that lie in its most complete form: Hecate does not return to the boundary’s edge. She returns to Gaia.
The new Veil grows from what survived the arc — not reconstructed but built from the work done in the dark. The Bond is its foundation. The daughters’ Web is woven through it. The compacts are its structure. The mortal world is not outside it. It is woven into it.
The fire solstice. The sun at its peak. The compact’s record opened on this day and the Restoration closes it on this day. Seven years. The Darkness’s first lie finally answered.
HecateGaiaThe Full NetworkDixie Calhoun

Eudora Calhoun, 89 years old by the time the compact is ratified, begins her tenure as Pike County’s Thinning holder. She is the sixth Calhoun generation. She will hold the door for fifty-three years. The holding was the waiting. The waiting was for the configuration that made the opening possible.
Mama Calhoun (Eudora)
~62 Years Before Year 0
Anselm’s First Refusal
Pre-History · OS4
Anselm Refuses to Kill the Thinning’s Holder
Anselm — last survivor of the Order’s founding generation — is sent to eliminate the Pike County corridor’s anchor. He finds her in her garden. She says: you look tired. Come in. He sits at her kitchen table for forty minutes. He files a false report. This is the first crack in the Order’s maintenance structure. He will carry this refusal for sixty more years.

Book 1 · Fallin’ for a Fallen
Key Event
Book 1
The Compact Ratified · Dixie & Azazel · The Seven-Year Cycle Begins
Raelee “Dixie” Calhoun — seventh Calhoun generation, musician, three outstanding warrants — turns down a road she’s never taken before. The compact she builds is real, which Mama Calhoun says is stronger than a planned arrangement would have been. The Morvael deal dissolved. The wrong compact replaced. The Pike County corridor’s jurisdiction formalized under the Older Mechanism’s bond law. The door opens.
The compact is ratified on the fire solstice — the longest day, the sun at its peak. The Older Mechanism’s record notes the date. Seven years later, on this same solstice, the Restoration will close the cycle.

Year 0
Book 2 · The Devil’s in the Details
Key Event
Book 2
Della & Samyaza · Brian Lee · Asmodeus Defeated
On the twenty-third morning Della Combs walks to the east fence. Samyaza tells her the truth. She tells him to get out of her house. She screams into a dish towel for forty-five seconds, washes it, goes back to work.
Asmodeus (Prince of Lust, 2nd-ranked on Hell’s administrative council) comes with a writ of acquisition for Brian Lee Combs — first Nephilim born to a chief Watcher in twelve thousand years. The writ rests on the Flood Clause — the framework’s founding Commission once ordered all Nephilim destroyed (Goliath as precedent), and it argues Brian Lee is not of the mortal layer, therefore unclaimed, therefore available; Asmodeus races the compact to close his claim first. The Cain-Abel clause defeats him: choosing betrayal as architecture binds his life force to Samyaza’s permanently. The older claim wins. It has always won.

Year 7 · Fire Solstice
DA12 · The Restoration
Key Event
DA12
Gaia and Hecate · The Fire Solstice · The Seven-Year Cycle Closes
The same fire solstice. Seven years after Dixie ratified the compact on the longest day of Year 0 — the same solar position, the same Older Mechanism calendar point, the same day the compact’s record was first opened — the Restoration happens.
Gaia and Hecate. The reunion. The Darkness told Hecate her mother’s warmth was a cage. The Restoration answers that lie in its most complete form: Hecate does not return to the boundary’s edge. She returns to Gaia.
The new Veil grows from what survived the arc — not reconstructed but built from the work done in the dark. The Bond is its foundation. The daughters’ Web is woven through it. The compacts are its structure. The mortal world is not outside it. It is woven into it.
The fire solstice. The sun at its peak. The compact’s record opened on this day and the Restoration closes it on this day. Seven years. The Darkness’s first lie finally answered.
